label: Desk Unsloth
description: The local agent's mediator (goal/G10.3): routes between the model at the connection's url and Andy's desk through this node's deskClient, answering the lines addressed to its persona and JOB lines, the call built fresh from the desk each time. Its two files are in its state folder: configuration.json (persona, preamble, model, contextLimit, answerTokens, bytesPerToken) and connection.json (url, key). Since goal/G14.2 it has a switch: connect {on} stops or resumes its asks for lines (off says signoff to the desk, so the persona leaves the live list at once), and state {} says whether it is connected, with its persona and model; deskUnslothRemote flips and reads them.
